payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-25 (ledger sweep): the premise has flipped. docs/ward-flow-coordination-rules.md now carries a 'STILL LIVE, must not be merged' marker for claude/Wardquestions, but neither claude/Wardquestions nor claude/Ward-design exists on origin any more (git ls-remote --heads origin shows no such refs). The marker is therefore wrong in the other direction, and the ten ward documents this row says existed only on claude/Wardquestions may now exist only in a local checkout, if anywhere. Next: owner confirms whether a local copy of claude/Wardquestions survives (e.g. D:\Repos\Database); if so push it back or fold its unique docs; then correct both docs' status markers.
